description:
Sites in crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/src/lib.rs:
- line 204:   pub until: Option<String>          // RecurrenceRule.until is a LocalDateTime per RFC 8984 §4.3.3
- line 469:   pub offset: String                  // OffsetTrigger.offset is a SignedDuration per RFC 8984 §4.5.2
- line 487:   pub when: String                    // AbsoluteTrigger.when is a UTC date-time
- line 445:   pub schedule_updated: Option<String> // Participant.scheduleUpdated is a UTC date-time
- line 561:   pub acknowledged: Option<String>    // Alert.acknowledged is a UTC date-time

The crate defines `LocalDateTime`, `Duration`, and `SignedDuration` as newtype wrappers around `String` precisely to document temporal intent at the type level (see lib.rs:18-27 design rationale: "These are modelled as newtype wrappers around String to document intent at the type level"). Then the fields that actually carry temporal values use raw `String` anyway, so the type-level documentation never reaches the consumer.

Doc-comment on line 469 even literally says "Duration offset from `relative_to` (SignedDuration string)" — the field SHOULD be typed `SignedDuration`, the docstring already names the right type.

For the UTC date-time fields (line 487 AbsoluteTrigger.when, line 445 Participant.scheduleUpdated, line 561 Alert.acknowledged) — these are not strictly RFC 8984 LocalDateTime; they are full UTC offset "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ". `jmap_types::UTCDate` is the right type, BUT this crate is documented as "jmap-types only for Id" — taking a UTCDate dep is consistent with that crate's already-imported `use jmap_types::Id` on line 33.

Why P3 (not P2): same wire format (all transparent newtypes), but invariant-on-the-type for parser/serializer is unenforced. Self-inconsistency: the crate goes to the trouble of defining the newtypes then doesn't apply them. Caller gets less type-level information than the source intent provides.

Suggested fix: change `until: Option<String>` → `Option<LocalDateTime>`, `offset: String` → `SignedDuration`, and the three UTC-date-time fields → `UTCDate` (which re-pulls jmap-types but that dep is already declared).

Note about RFC 8984 "until" — §4.3.3 says `until` is a LocalDateTime, not a UTC date-time. So `until` is correctly typed `Option<LocalDateTime>` not `Option<UTCDate>`.
title: P3: jscalendar-types defines LocalDateTime/Duration/SignedDuration newtypes but doesn't use them for fields of those types
